blocks.prompt: 9 We say that two vectors \(\underline{v}\) and \(\underline{w}\) in space are parallel if there is a scalar \(c\) such that \(\underline{v} = c\underline{w}\). The vectors point in the same direction if \(c > 0\) and in the opposite direction if \(c < 0\). (a) Find two vectors of length 2 parallel to the vector \(\underline{v} = 2\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yahan do jawab chahiye: ek \(\underline{v}\) ki apni direction mein aur ek bilkul ulti direction mein. Dono parallel kehlate hain, kyunke definition mein \(c\) positive bhi ho sakta hai aur negative bhi.
Diya kya hai? \(\underline{v} = 2\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\) aur lambai 2.
Plan: unit vector \(\underline{v}/|\underline{v}|\) banayenge, phir usay \(2\) aur \(-2\) dono se multiply karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{v} = 2\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\), lambai 2.
Humein find karna hai: 2 lambai ke do vectors jo \(\underline{v}\) ke parallel hon.
Tareeqa: \(\pm 2\,\underline{v}/|\underline{v}|\). Unit vector direction deta hai; \(+2\) same taraf aur \(-2\) ulti taraf 2 lambai deta hai.

Unit vector
\[\dfrac{\underline{v}}{6} = \dfrac{1}{3}\underline{i} - \dfrac{2}{3}\underline{j} + \dfrac{2}{3}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Har component ko 6 se divide kiya aur fractions chhote kiye: \(2/6 = 1/3\), \(4/6 = 2/3\). Ab lambai 1 hai.

\(2\) aur \(-2\) se multiply karein
\[\tfrac{2}{3}\underline{i} - \tfrac{4}{3}\underline{j} + \tfrac{4}{3}\underline{k}\]
\[-\tfrac{2}{3}\underline{i} + \tfrac{4}{3}\underline{j} - \tfrac{4}{3}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Pehla vector \(\underline{v}\) ka \(\tfrac{1}{3}\) guna hai (\(c > 0\), same direction), dusra \(-\tfrac{1}{3}\) guna (\(c < 0\), ulti direction). Dono ki lambai 2 hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{4 + 16 + 16}{9} = \dfrac{36}{9} = 4\]
\[\sqrt{4} = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono vectors ke components ke size ek jaise hain, sirf signs ulte, is liye dono ki lambai 2 hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\frac{2}{3}\underline{i} - \frac{4}{3}\underline{j} + \frac{4}{3}\underline{k}\) aur \(-\frac{2}{3}\underline{i} + \frac{4}{3}\underline{j} - \frac{4}{3}\underline{k}\)
Ek same direction mein, dusra ulti direction mein.

blocks.prompt: 9 We say that two vectors \(\underline{v}\) and \(\underline{w}\) in space are parallel if there is a scalar \(c\) such that \(\underline{v} = c\underline{w}\). The vectors point in the same direction if \(c > 0\) and in the opposite direction if \(c < 0\). (b) Find the constant \(a\) so that the vectors \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = a\underline{i} + 9\underline{j} - 12\underline{k}\) are parallel.
blocks.explanation:
Parallel ka matlab hai \(\underline{w} = c\underline{v}\), jahan \(c\) ek hi number hai jo teeno components par lagta hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\underline{v}\) poora, aur \(\underline{w}\) jis mein \(a\) unknown hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(a\).
Plan: \(\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{k}\) wale components dono vectors mein maloom hain, un se \(c\) nikalenge, phir \(\underline{i}\) component se \(a\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = a\underline{i} + 9\underline{j} - 12\underline{k}\), aur yeh parallel hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(a\).
Tareeqa: \(\underline{w} = c\underline{v}\) likh kar components compare karenge.

\(\underline{w} = c\underline{v}\) likhein
\[a\underline{i} + 9\underline{j} - 12\underline{k}\]
\[= c\underline{i} - 3c\underline{j} + 4c\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Parallel vectors ki definition: ek vector dusre ka scalar multiple hai. \(c\) ko \(\underline{v}\) ke har component se zarb diya.

\(\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{k}\) se \(c\) nikalein
\[9 = -3c \Rightarrow c = -3\]
\[-12 = 4c \Rightarrow c = -3\]
Kyun: Dono components se ek hi \(c = -3\) aaya. Yeh zaroori check hai: agar dono se alag \(c\) aata to vectors kabhi parallel na ho sakte, chahe \(a\) kuch bhi ho.

\(a\) nikalein
\[a = c \times 1 = -3\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\) components compare kiye: \(a = c \cdot 1 = -3\). \(c\) negative hai, is liye \(\underline{w}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ulti directions mein hain.

Tasdeeq
\[-3\underline{v} = -3\underline{i} + 9\underline{j} - 12\underline{k} = \underline{w} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\underline{v}\) ko \(-3\) se multiply kiya to bilkul \(\underline{w}\) mila, jab \(a = -3\) ho.

blocks.prompt: 9 We say that two vectors \(\underline{v}\) and \(\underline{w}\) in space are parallel if there is a scalar \(c\) such that \(\underline{v} = c\underline{w}\). The vectors point in the same direction if \(c > 0\) and in the opposite direction if \(c < 0\). (c) Find a vector of length 5 in the direction opposite that of \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\).
blocks.explanation:
Ulti direction ka matlab hai \(\underline{v}\) ka negative multiple (\(c < 0\)).
Diya kya hai? \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\) aur lambai 5.
Plan: \(\underline{v}\) ka unit vector banayenge aur usay \(-5\) se multiply karenge: minus sign direction ulta karega aur 5 lambai dega.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), lambai 5, ulti direction.
Humein find karna hai: matloob vector.
Tareeqa: \(-5\,\underline{v}/|\underline{v}|\). Unit vector direction, minus sign ulta rukh, aur 5 lambai.

\(|\underline{v}|\) nikalein
\[|\underline{v}| = \sqrt{1 + 4 + 9} = \sqrt{14}\]
Kyun: Magnitude formula: \(1^2 + (-2)^2 + 3^2 = 14\). 14 mein koi square factor nahi, to \(\sqrt{14}\) hi rahega.

Unit vector ko \(-5\) se multiply karein
\[-\dfrac{5}{\sqrt{14}}(\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k})\]
\[= \dfrac{-5\underline{i} + 10\underline{j} - 15\underline{k}}{\sqrt{14}}\]
Kyun: Minus sign har component ka sign ulta kar deta hai, yani direction ulti ho gayi; 5 lambai set karta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(-2\) ko \(-5\) se zarb dein to \(+10\) banta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{25 + 100 + 225}{14} = \dfrac{350}{14} = 25\]
\[\sqrt{25} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Lambai 5 aayi, aur yeh \(\underline{v}\) ka \(-5/\sqrt{14}\) guna hai, jo negative hai, is liye direction ulti hai. Dono shartein poori.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\dfrac{-5\underline{i} + 10\underline{j} - 15\underline{k}}{\sqrt{14}}\)
Ulti direction = unit vector ka negative multiple.

blocks.prompt: 9 We say that two vectors \(\underline{v}\) and \(\underline{w}\) in space are parallel if there is a scalar \(c\) such that \(\underline{v} = c\underline{w}\). The vectors point in the same direction if \(c > 0\) and in the opposite direction if \(c < 0\). (d) Find \(a\) and \(b\) so that the vectors \(3\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\) and \(a\underline{i} + b\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\) are parallel.
blocks.explanation:
Parallel ka matlab: \(a\underline{i} + b\underline{j} - 2\underline{k} = c(3\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 4\underline{k})\) kisi ek number \(c\) ke liye.
Diya kya hai? Do vectors, dusre mein do unknowns \(a\) aur \(b\).
Plan: sirf \(\underline{k}\) wala component dono taraf maloom hai, us se \(c\) nikalenge; phir \(\underline{i}\) se \(a\) aur \(\underline{j}\) se \(b\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(3\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\) aur \(a\underline{i} + b\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\) parallel hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(a\) aur \(b\).
Tareeqa: dusre vector ko pehle ka \(c\) guna likh kar components compare karenge.

Shart likhein
\[a\underline{i} + b\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\]
\[= 3c\underline{i} - c\underline{j} + 4c\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Parallel vectors ki definition se dusra vector pehle ka scalar multiple hai.

\(\underline{k}\) se \(c\) nikalein
\[-2 = 4c \Rightarrow c = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{k}\) component hi aisa hai jo dono taraf maloom number hai, is liye wahan se \(c\) seedha mil gaya. \(c\) negative hai, to vectors ulti directions mein honge.

\(a\) aur \(b\) nikalein
\[a = 3c = -\dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[b = -c = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\): \(a = 3c = 3 \times (-\tfrac{1}{2}) = -\tfrac{3}{2}\). \(\underline{j}\): \(b = -c = -(-\tfrac{1}{2}) = \tfrac{1}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\underline{j}\) ka coefficient \(-1\) hai, is liye \(b = -c\); minus ko mat bhooliye.

Tasdeeq
\[-\tfrac{1}{2}(3\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 4\underline{k})\]
\[= -\tfrac{3}{2}\underline{i} + \tfrac{1}{2}\underline{j} - 2\underline{k} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Pehle vector ko \(-\tfrac{1}{2}\) se multiply kiya to bilkul hamara dusra vector bana. Jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(a = -\frac{3}{2},\ b = \frac{1}{2}\)
Dono vectors parallel hain lekin ulti directions mein (\(c = -\tfrac{1}{2}\)).
